supported: Built, installed and played on this kind of device for every release.
partial: Plays, with a limitation named in the notes.
experimental: Built for every release and started in a simulator or container, but not yet played on a real device.
untested: Built for every release, but never run on this kind of device yet. It should work; please tell us if it doesn't.
unsupported: No version for this platform yet.
